title: Taroters
description: Mod that adds all the 78 tarot cards at Minecraft
body:
Taroters is a mod for NeoForge 1.21.4 that adds a faithful recreation of the iconic 78 cards from the Tarot.

 

NeoForge 1.21.4
Project status: ON

 

Designed with performance and compatibility in mind, this mod does not alter vanilla mechanics or add any unnecessary content.

Whether you’re starting a cozy RPG server or enhancing your personal survival world, Taroters brings a touch of magic and nostalgia to Minecraft.

 

Features:
Over 78 cards from the Tarot, each with unique characteristics

This mod adds the Tarot Shard. This is useful to craft the cards. This mod adds the Tarot block for decoration also.

 

Tarot Shard Recipe:

4 diamonds

4 amethyst shards

1 gunpowder



 

Card Recipe:

4 tarot shards

1 paper



 

Once you have at least one card, think of a question you want to ask the tarot and right-click to get the reading. If you don't ask a question, a random card will be drawn.

You can do a tarot reading regardless of the cards you have. A minimum of 3 and a maximum of 5 are recommended.

Enjoy the experience :3
